sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 16 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 6 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies World Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases critical hit chance by 100%, and nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000
Paralysis and Blind Resistance Up by 60

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
